confirmDeleteCategory: Delete this category and all its decisions?
visVisibleTip: Default. Both the category and its decisions export to your mod.
visSoloTip: Show this category here only. Does not change what gets exported.
visHiddenTip: The category and its decisions won't export, but their text still does — so you won't get missing-text keys in game.
hiddenCatHint: Decisions in a hidden category aren't exported, but their localisation still is.
newCatPlaceholder: e.g. war_measures (type a name then click +)
catCollisionWarn: Shares a name with a vanilla decision category — your mod will override vanilla's when it loads.
noCategorySelectedDesc: Create or select a category from the left panel, then pick a decision to edit.
categoryIconUploadHint: PNG / JPG / DDS. Converted to DDS on export; the GFX name is generated for you.
categoryPictureHint: Optional GFX reference for the category's 256×256 background picture (distinct from the tab icon). Type a vanilla or mod sprite name — the game provides the sprite.
categoryMapAreaHint: Optional · moves the camera to the listed state(s) when the category button is clicked. Type the inner block content (state = N · name = loc_key · zoom = 50-3000); export wraps it in the on_map_area block automatically.
placementTooltip: Drag to reorder decision categories; priority is recomputed automatically.
createCategoryToStart: Create a category to start adding decisions
emptyHeroTitle: Decisions are where players take action
emptyHeroDesc: Timed actions, ongoing projects, national missions — start with a category
